programmes.d: Detectives chase "Fufu," a villain who stole Escobar's stash from the LAPD. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect a witness.
No matter how hard you try to make it out the streets, something always tries to pull you back in.
Two young men grow up together, graduate college and attempt to start their professional lives. When one takes matters into his own hands, the only family he has winds up with a target on their back.
Blood is not always thicker than water, and not all friends are as loyal as you think. Four different relationships display love, hurt, and betrayal.

Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate's wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.
To avenge her sister's death, a woman must dive into the neon-lit criminal underworld that consumed her.
After fleeing under a new identity following a suspected double murder, a man's quiet life in Florida unravels as neighbors probe his past.

In 2004, Ruby, a college student, witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty.
Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession.
When her husband is taken by terrorists, an Army veteran turned politician dusts off her combat skills for a high-stakes rescue mission.

When Ruth is hired to babysit for the Harris family, she and the children find out that someone else is watching them closely. Ruth and Jasmine have to fight to protect themselves and her little brother Micah.

Ten years after a liquor store robbery left their sister dead and their father shattered, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are ready to take justice into their own hands.

Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival; after moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club and quickly rises to the top.
Detectives chase "Fufu," a villain who stole Escobar's stash from the LAPD. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect a witness.
